data: 30 exclusively source-tagged ambient recordings; existing 24 physical and 8 timing records. First complete lexicographic normal PMU; unchanged abnormal candidates. No quietness-based selection.
normal_evidence: PNNL collection includes ambient operating conditions; exclusive nonspecific steady-state source tags; waveform integrity checks. This does not prove absence of all sensor artifacts.
cadence: 30 Hz verified from waveform timestamps; declared source metadata discrepancies recorded; no resampling
groups: Provider/month normal and physical records share existing family IDs. Three timing families retained. Stratify timing and other source groups into three outer folds; two inner folds when only two timing families remain.
detector: 23 unchanged context features, RF 300 trees seed42, equal class then family then record weight. Inner leaf1/3/5 macro F1 selection; separate normal/abnormal cutoffs requiring observed95% precision per returned class; abstain if infeasible.
cause: Outer models fitted only on outer training abnormal families with nested selection. Deployment uses frozen original v3 cause bundle.
report: All normal false alarms, abnormal misses and abstentions; full pipeline 3x4 matrix and coverage. Compare development targets95% abnormal recall/5% false alarms without changing policy after outcomes.
stop: One fixed experiment; retain results even if targets fail. Previously examined abnormal data remain development data. No independent final confirmation is claimed.
